item.title: Fans Choose The Rolling Stones’ ‘Foreign Tongues’ as This Week’s Favorite New Music
item.description:
[Energetic music fades out, and the host's voice takes over]
Host: "Welcome to this week's music update! We've got the latest from Billboard, and it's a big one. The Rolling Stones have taken the top spot with their brand-new album, 'Foreign Tongues'! This is their 25th full-length studio release, folks, and it's clear that fans are loving it. In a poll published on Billboard, listeners voted 'Foreign Tongues' as their favorite new music, beating out new releases from YEONJUN, Beyoncé, and Feid.
[Short music clip from "Foreign Tongues" plays]
Host: "So, what makes 'Foreign Tongues' so special? For starters, it features 14 fresh tracks, including 12 new originals and two covers - Amy Winehouse's 'You Know I'm No Good' and Chuck Berry's 'Beautiful Delilah'. The album was recorded with producer Andrew Watt at Metropolis Studios in West London, and it's a real collaborative effort, with contributions from Steve Winwood, Paul McCartney, Robert Smith of The Cure, and Chad Smith of the Red Hot Chili Peppers, among others.
[Short music clip from "In the Stars" plays]
Host: "Mick Jagger and Ronnie Wood have shared their thoughts on the recording process, with Mick saying it was 'a very intense few weeks' and Ronnie describing the room's vibe as 'so creative'. And, in a special tribute, the album features drums played by the late Charlie Watts on the track 'Hit Me in the Head'.
[Short music clip from "Jealous Lover" plays]
Host: "So, how did the poll results shake out? 'Foreign Tongues' took a whopping 42% of the vote, followed by YEONJUN's 'No Labels: Part 02' with 36%, Beyoncé's 'Morning Dew (Donk)' with nearly 8%, and Feid's 'A Xon De Que' with over 7%. That's it for this week's music update. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you next time!"
[Upbeat music fades in, and the host's voice wraps up]
Host: "Don't forget to check out 'Foreign Tongues' by The Rolling Stones, available now. And, if you want to stay up-to-date on the latest music news, follow us on social media or visit our website. See you next time!"
